name: Dog Ear
summary: A book card whose 3D cover swings open to a sample you can page through, dog-ear and shelve
about: A book card with a clothbound novel standing in 3D on a reading desk, its gold foil catching the light. Open it and the book turns to face you, the cover swings back on its spine and the first pages flutter. Turn pages with the buttons, the arrow keys or by dragging a page across, fold a corner to keep your place, then close it and add it to your shelf, where it drops into the gap between the other books.
how: Tap the cover or Read a sample: the book straightens and the cover swings open.
Turn pages with the arrows below, the arrow keys, a tap on either page or by dragging a page.
Tap the top corner of a right-hand page to dog-ear it; tap again to unfold it.
Close the book to watch the pages fall back and the cover shut.
Pick a format to see its price, and add the book to your shelf.
